phase: CD-4 — L3 Candidate Funnel Infrastructure (recall & compression research, not ranking)
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 (four research questions RQ1-RQ4; sector as metadata; fail-closed; recall evaluated with future outcomes for EVALUATION ONLY)
sampling_grid: monthly checkpoints (last trading day of each month, 2021-01..2026-09, 70 checkpoints) — funnel state evaluated at each; candidate pool dynamics measured across checkpoints

rules.EXCLUDED_NEW: fewer than 120 trading days of history at T
rules.EXCLUDED_DELISTED_SOON: PIT-safe formulation: no lookahead — simply absent if no more data after T (a stock with data at T is eligible; survivorship handled by universe construction)
rules.EXCLUDED_SUSPENDED: fewer than 10 trading days with volume>0 in trailing 60 sessions at T
rules.EXCLUDED_LOW_PRICE: qfq close < 2.0 CNY at T (DECLARED proxy for delisting-risk/ST shell — st_flag is a declared DATA-1 gap)
rules.EXCLUDED_ILLIQUID: trailing 20-session mean volume below the 2nd percentile of the whole market's 20d mean volumes at T (volume as DECLARED amount substitute)

rq1_exclusions_frozen.census_output: per checkpoint: excluded counts by reason, remaining pool size; reasons never overridden

rq2_triggers_frozen.principle: three timescales under capital-structure mainline; each trigger is a cheap observable, trailing-only
rq2_triggers_frozen.T_LONG (monthly capital background): qfq close at T > its 24-month (approx 500-session) mean AND 24-month qfq return > 0 — 'worth watching'
rq2_triggers_frozen.T_MID (weekly participation/momentum cha: 13-week (65-session) qfq return > 0 AND stock volume-share of market (stock 20d mean volume / market 20d mean total volume) higher at T than its own 52-week (250-session) median by factor > 1.5 — 'capital behavior changing'
rq2_triggers_frozen.T_SHORT (daily structure event): within trailing 20 sessions at T: qfq close made a 60-session new high on a day with volume > 2x that stock's trailing-20 mean — 'entered state needing deep inspection'

metrics_per_checkpoint: recall_top_decile_60d: share of stocks in the forward-60d top decile of market-relative return (computed among LEVEL_EXCL, evaluation only) that are retained at each level
turnover: Jaccard distance between candidate pools at consecutive checkpoints
stability: median consecutive-checkpoint survival of candidates
rq3_evaluation_frozen.target_compression_reference: report pool sizes at all levels vs the ~1000/500/200/100 reference marks; NO optimization of triggers to hit a mark
rq3_evaluation_frozen.dev_holdout: dev 2021-01..2023-12 / holdout 2024-01..2026-09 reported separately; forward windows extending past 2026-09-30 excluded (incomplete)

rq4_sector_metadata_frozen.attach: for every LEVEL_FULL candidate at checkpoint T: sector_state (base at T), sector_path (any path label at T), narrowing_risk (NARROWING active within trailing 10 sessions of its L2), divergent (base=DIVERGENT at T), sw2_context_if_needed (deferred: populated on demand at L4/L5, RETROSPECTIVE label)
